method: Independent full decode with double-precision volume followed immediately by FFmpeg loudnorm input metering. After gain is calibrated scale times maximum catalogue role gain; before gain is 0.8 divided by decoded sample peak times the same catalogue role gain. No intermediate PCM clipping, compression, audio-file edits or master attenuation. Every input content hash verified.

predictionNote: LUFS arithmetic predicts calibration reference levels. Absolute-gated integrated loudness can shift nonlinearly after catalogue attenuation removes very quiet tail blocks. Measured output takes precedence: the initial +/-0.3 LU prediction-comparison probe exceeded that diagnostic bound for 37 codec files, with maximum residual 1.786375 LU; this is recorded rather than treated as an exact level-matching guarantee.
